Near T3-040: c0315 (apologising for the community over the N7 logo), c0394 (rebuilding the images the room destroyed), c0317 (an old-school poster offering to rebuild what they destroyed elsewhere). Near T3-087: c0455 and c0459 (a streamer's fans blamed, then the cause corrected). c0309 (the old-school sub laying down arms to help) is rivals turned partners, an open distinction. Peripheral: c0337, c0472. Named plainly; nothing left out or softened.
